name: Tanjiro Kamado
summary: After recovering at the Butterfly Mansion, Tanjiro completed intensive rehabilitation and learned Total Concentration: Constant. His physical abilities increased substantially, allowing him to fight stronger demons and eventually confront Enmu and Daki. He further developed his Hinokami Kagura and learned to combine it with Water Breathing.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Several Meters with Breathing Styles

weaknesses: Using Water Breathing immediately before Hinokami Kagura places severe strain on his body
notes: Tanjiro's Post-Rehabilitation Training key. He is at least 8-C normally, with Constant Flux increasing his power, Hinokami Kagura reaching Low 7-C, and the Demon Slayer Mark reaching 7-C.
